certificationRecommendation: Previously identified wrong-volume coverage gap is closed for the requested bounded filesystem security audit. Overall certification remains conditional on parent final validation and all other acceptance gates.

assessment.requiredScope: User section29 actual Windows wrong-volume negative, interpreted as a real attempted escape to another filesystem volume. The user does not require bypassing earlier frozen guards solely to reach every downstream defensive branch.
assessment.actualObservation: Owned directory symbolic link on source volume bec58120 targeted existing NTFS volume GUID12dbd20e-1280-4ec0-abfa-22933ac79b60 with independently observed volumeSerial7a4fed9b. A real fixed-helper READ_SET attempted the path through that link and returned an ERROR frame with MO1307_FILESYSTEM_BOUNDARY, empty files and roots. Fixed supervisor recorded one helper, no worker, exit confirmed and quiescence. The link was removed nonrecursively; target root metadata was unchanged.
assessment.rejectionPoint: The ERROR frame contains no branch telemetry. Native reparse refusal is supported by source ordering: Open-Native opens with OPEN_REPARSE_POINT|BACKUP_SEMANTICS at windows-inspect.ps1:188; Read-Identity rejects reparse attributes at208; Open-Chain calls that before comparing volumeSerial at246. This is a source-supported explanation of the observed rejection, not independently traced branch execution.
assessment.separateLayers: The existing synthetic cross-slot volumeSerial substitution still separately proves response identity-change refusal. Native source review confirms component-volume comparison. These are kept distinct from the actual cross-volume namespace escape witness.
limits: Native execution of the downstream volumeSerial mismatch branch remains unproven.
Successful ordinary acquisition on the other volume is not claimed.
Distinct volume serials prove different filesystem volumes, not separate physical disks.
Only root metadata was read on the target volume; no contents/enumeration/target write, new volume, mount or drive assignment was part of the witness.
No privileged concurrent namespace attacker or protection beyond the frozen private immutable-root assumption is certified.
assessment.whyGapCloses: Earlier review had only source review and supplied identities, so actual Windows wrong-volume coverage was absent. This additional witness supplies a genuine different-volume target and an actual production native-helper rejection. Refusal at an earlier mandatory guard is the correct boundary behavior, rather than a reason to bypass that guard or demand an artificial deeper branch.
